items.text: Dallas (TBD): S Caleb Downs and S P.J. Locke (both concussion protocol), TE Jake Ferguson (low ankle sprain), LB Malachi Lawrence (ankle, could miss time), LB Dee Winters (calf), WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs). LB Marist Liufau and DT Jonathan Bullard on IR (21-day windows); S Jalen Thompson on IR.

Indianapolis: Daniel Jones remains the starter, Anthony Richardson QB2. CB Justin Walley (knee) TBD; CB Cam Taylor-Britt, WR Alec Pierce, DE Micheal Clemons on IR (DE Arden Key eligible Week 9). Colts traded LG Quenton Nelson (SEA) and DT DeForest Buckner (SF) last week.
